dedupe_keys.name: global supply chain logistics data for a medium size excavator veluscek and kalganova

description: This is a family of figshare datasets describing the global supply chain of one product, a medium-size excavator. The data came from a manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives; the figshare titles name the company as Caterpillar. According to the description, the company sells more than 3 million products and 700,000 parts in more than 20 countries, with more than 3,000 suppliers and 3,000 dealerships and logistics worth over 60 million dollars a year. The base dataset (version 4, 20 January 2016) gives the logistics problem for the excavator. Two variants keep the original numbers of dealers, production facilities and shipping ports but draw demand, production capacity, transport times and costs and sale prices at random: one from a negative exponential distribution, one uniformly. An extended dataset followed on 24 February 2016. Coverage is a worldwide network of plants, ports and dealers for one product. Access is free as zipped files of under 1 MB each on figshare under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: the real figures were replaced or randomised, locations are not given as coordinates on the page read, and the data date from 2016. For simulation it is a benchmark network for optimisation and for disruption studies of a manufacturing supply chain, such as plant or port outages. Related catalogue records include the Acclimate and BoARIO supply-chain loss models.
